text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hau~. I can't believe I failed 5 whole 
subjects~.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And to make matters worse, the remedial 
classes are three hours long every single 
day...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Is Falco in a total, desperate crisis?! 
Forget about umadol activities, I might 
even get held back a year?!"

Smart Falcon's screams echoed around us, 
but there was simply nothing that could be 
done about it...
